title: Software3dAdapter
responsibility: Render a simple projected game scene on a 2D canvas when a WebGL renderer cannot be created.

inputs.name: Software3dAdapter.constructor.canvas
inputs.description: Browser canvas owned by this renderer or canvas-only stream transport.

inputs.name: Software3dAdapter.render.run
inputs.description: Current deterministic game state, tick and checkpoint execution results.

inputs.name: Software3dAdapter.render._view
inputs.description: Input to the renderer or transport operation named by this contract.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Unavailable transport, cancellation or connection failure; native rendering remains independent.
